# Alt.FFF (Alternative Fashion Fabric Fair)

> Where materials speak before fashion. Alt.FFF is Ghana's first alternative fashion fabric fair - a curated platform redefining the future of fashion by placing African materials at the centre of global design conversations.

Alt.FFF brings together manufacturers, material producers, designers, and buyers from across Africa and beyond for a one-day trade fair of fibres, dyes, weaves, and the people behind them.

- Dates: Saturday 19th September. 2026 (exhibitor set-up Friday 18th September. 2026)
- Venue: The Palms Convention Centre, La Palm Royal Beach Hotel, Accra Ghana
- Organiser: Fashion Forum Africa
- Contact: enquiries@altfff.com
